sentence_stem: Even though the test was difficult,
full_sentence: Even though the test was difficult, most students passed it comfortably.
acceptable_variants: many students still passed it easily.
most students passed it without much trouble.

options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated event. 'Even though' needs a clause that contrasts with the difficulty mentioned in the stem.
'So' signals a result, which clashes with the concessive connector 'even though'.

options.text: the test was held in the morning.
options.why_wrong: This gives a neutral detail and does not show a contrast with the difficulty described in the stem.

explanation: After 'even though', the main clause must show an outcome that goes against the expected effect of the difficulty. Learners sometimes choose a result clause introduced by 'so', which breaks the concessive relation.
translation: Mesmo que a prova fosse difícil, a maioria dos alunos foi aprovada com facilidade.
